snippet.title: LOOP – Atmospheric Platformer | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
LOOP is an atmospheric puzzle adventure set in a constantly shifting world where every escape leads to another nightmare.

Explore abandoned places, survive unsettling encounters, and solve environmental puzzles in this atmospheric 2.5D puzzle adventure where every new discovery only leads to more questions. Slow Horror and sudden chaos keeps you on your toes.
The deeper you go, the more the line between nightmare and reality begins to disappear.
Hidden clues, fractured memories, and unsettling encounters slowly uncover a truth that never stays the same long enough to understand.
